tool_args.rationale: The pilot horizons are at most 0.48, far shorter than the target horizon of 21.5. A slow-horizon probe directly tests the recalled reversal mechanism and constrains otherwise unidentifiable slow dynamics.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a dual-horizon adaptation model to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify the slow component needed for a 21.5-unit forecast, particularly with an observed sink-gradient effect.
Fine short-window trajectories would be less informative about long-horizon reversal.
The short pilot does not distinguish these from endogenous adaptation at the target horizon.
